name: smwmusic-natsuki-crisis-battle-staff-roll
title: Natsuki Crisis Battle - Staff Roll
description:
Credits theme from Natsuki Crisis Battle.

You can switch between the original non-looped version and looped version:
set define to #define loop 1, to get the looped version
set define to #define loop 0, to get the original non-looped version

Note that most vanilla samples had to be omitted, so only use this for credits (or title)
